title: Merge Sorted Array
summary: Combine two sorted sequences into nums1.

contractDetails.constraints: nums1 has length m+n and nums2 has length n. 0 ≤ m,n ≤ 200 and 1 ≤ m+n ≤ 200. Real values are in [−1000000000,1000000000]. The real portions are sorted. Serialize nums1 after the void call. R returns the updated vector.
contractDetails.output-checking: Call merge(nums1,m,nums2,n), then serialize mutated nums1. R returns the updated vector.

statement: Combine two sorted sequences into nums1. Its first m entries are real data and its final n entries are unused zero placeholders. nums2 contains n real entries. Change nums1 to hold all m+n values in nondecreasing order.

examples.explanation: All stored values come from nums2.
No values need to be merged from nums2.

hints: Conceptual: Writing at the front could overwrite unread entries.
Directional: Fill the available positions from the end.
Implementation: Compare the last unread real values. Write the larger one into the last free slot and move its read position backward.
complexityAnalysis: O(m+n) time and O(1) auxiliary space in mutable representations.
